automatic_proof_scope: Explicit forward Ackermann static path witness under .40 rad steering/.75 rad_s slew and .33m margin plus .03m sample envelope
Five-ray initial occlusion proxy and constant-speed interaction proxy
pending_live_or_new_version: Correct any actor/static swept penetration before live qualification; preserve these diagnostic layouts
Exact raycast visibility including all scan beams and actual ego motion
Full common-gate response timing with a versioned plugin
Wire named RNG streams and test reset/call-order invariance
Live source-stamp TF/odom/scan/time and wheel/body settling
Real dynamic interaction under every method; proxy is not navigation/performance evidence
Route/world transformations integrated into planner observation/map/path/evaluator and actor activation; pure functions alone are insufficient
planning_limitations: Static witness ignores actors and shows existence only; it does not certify learned candidate coverage or completion within 22s.
Search has finite40000-node computation limit; no witness is not a proof of geometric impossibility.
Witness runs at0.4m/s with steering actuator timeconstant.18s and.75rad/s; steering cap.40 is conservative relative to actual plugin.4964.
Witness uses convex hull of actual horizontal chassis and all four projected wheel cylinders with inner/outer Ackermann steering; roll/pitch/vertical geometry remains a live gate.
Five-ray visibility is a geometric screening test, not a complete scan simulation.
